Migrated the repo from SQLAlchemy 1.4 to 2.0.

Code changes:
- src/coilmq/store/sa/__init__.py: MetaData(bind=...) -> MetaData() (engine is passed explicitly to create_all/drop_all); select([...]) list form -> positional select(...) in all queries; Row indexing by Column object -> Row._mapping[...] in dequeue().
- src/coilmq/store/sa/model.py: metadata.create_all()/drop_all() now receive meta.engine explicitly.

Dependency pins (pyproject.toml):
- optional-dependencies.sqlalchemy: "sqlalchemy<2" -> "sqlalchemy>=2.0"
- dependency-groups.tests: "sqlalchemy<2" -> "sqlalchemy>=2.0"
No companion packages in the repo depend on SQLAlchemy.

Test results: final run 201 passed, 0 failed, 3 skipped (204 total); all 34 SQLAlchemy-backed tests pass.

Notes for review:
- tests/protocol/test_1_1.py::TestSTOMP11::test_no_heartbeat_from_client is timing-sensitive (it sleeps 0.203s and expects a heartbeat disconnect). It failed on four earlier runs and passed on the final run. It doesn't touch SQLAlchemy, and I did not change the heartbeat code (an exploratory timer edit in src/coilmq/util/concurrency.py was reverted). The test's FIXME refers to issue #64; that may be worth addressing separately.
- Optional tidy-up not done: docs/conf.py still points intersphinx at the SQLAlchemy 1.4 docs (https://docs.sqlalchemy.org/en/14/).
